title: nf-core/createpanelrefs assay datasheet schema
description: Schema for the assay datasheet provided with --assay. Each property maps a datasheet key to a pipeline parameter; other datasheet keys are ignored.

genome.errorMessage: Genome name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

gcnv_target_bed.errorMessage: gCNV target BED must end in '.bed' and cannot contain spaces

gcnv_target_interval_list.errorMessage: gCNV target interval list must end in '.interval_list' and cannot contain spaces

gens_interval_list.errorMessage: GENS interval list must end in '.interval_list' and cannot contain spaces

mutect2_target_bed.errorMessage: Mutect2 target BED must end in '.bed' and cannot contain spaces
